text:
deploy-bot: ✅ Finished rollout step: release v3.15.0 -> prod/us-west. Kicking off post-deploy verifications: healthchecks + synthetic probes. Docs: https://redwood.example/releases/v3.15.0

alex: quick glance: overall health OK but synth embed p95 spiked on two hosts to ~480ms (baseline ~160). HTTP gateway p50 fine.

sam: confirmed. three synth runs: 12/15 OK, 3 slow. pattern looks like low kv hit-rate on those hosts.

maria: we just changed model sharding for embed-v2 in this release (smaller shard size to reduce memory). that could increase cold-kv misses until prefill completes.

opsbot: auto-alert: synth_p95 > 300ms for region us-west (rolling window 5m). Severity: low.

jin: starting controlled prefill: `infra/warmupctl prefill --service embedding --model embed-v2 --hosts host[12-14] --concurrency 8`
jin: setting synth probe rate to 30s for increased sampling: `infra/synthctl set-rate --region us-west --rate 30s`

deploy-bot: synth run (after prefill kicked): 18 probes -> 15 OK, 3 slow. aggregated p95 = 320ms. kv hit rate measured at 72% on affected hosts (baseline 92%).

alex: 320ms is better but still above expected. options: A) pin routing for us-west to embed-v1 (older bundle) for 45m, continue warmup; B) rollback the region to last stable release v3.14.x; C) keep rolling and monitor with extended prefill. Thoughts?

sam: prefer pin (A) to buy time for prefill and avoid customer impact. rollback seems heavy-handed if only synths and no user-facing errors.

maria: agree with pin. also recommend we add a short note to the release changelog and notify CS: "Hold in us-west: embedding routes pinned to embed-v1 while we prefill embed-v2 caches."

opsbot: runbook reminder: For synth_p95 variance under 500ms and error rate < 0.5%, prefer pin+warmup over rollback.

jin: applying pin: `deployctl pin-route --svc embedding --to model:embed-v1 --scope region:us-west --duration 45m --reason "post-deploy synth elevated p95; prefill running"`
jin: deployctl response: PIN_OK (pid-20250601-77)

deploy-bot: pin applied pid-20250601-77. synth frequency remains elevated; warmup jobs running.

alex: monitoring targets
- p95 (embed) per-host (alex)
- kv hit-rate + prefill progress (sam)
- user-facing error budget (maria)

sam: starting a trace capture for the three hosts and enabling detailed kv logs for 20m: `telemetryctl capture --hosts host12,host13,host14 --duration 20m --profiles kv,traces`
jin: note: if prefill doesn't reach kv hit-rate >=85% and p95 < 200ms within 45m, we'll escalate to rollback.

maria: updated release notes + posted banner in #status: "us-west: embeddings pinned to embed-v1 while we prefill embed-v2 caches. Monitoring in progress."

deploy-bot: hold timer set: 45m. automated resume will occur unless extended or manual rollback triggered.

alex: filing short incident ticket for tracking: INC-2025-042 (post-deploy synth variance). I'll paste findings there as we go.

sam: will post an update at +15m and +30m. ping me for rollback if metrics worsen.

jin: warmup job logs (snippet):
```
[00:01] prefill host12: started shards 0-3
[00:03] prefill host12: kv miss -> fetching 23MB weights
[00:07] prefill host12: completed shards 0-3, hits rising
```

opsbot: automation note: When pin active, traffic routing will shift but autoscaler will still scale embed-v2 hosts for background prefill.

alex: ACK. holding for now.
